text:
**Nationwide FlexDirect pays the highest rate I found on the UK current-account balance itself:** **5% AER fixed for 12 months on the first £1,500**, with no monthly fee. Money above £1,500 earns no interest, and after the first year the rate drops to 1% AER variable. Rates checked **21 November 2026**. ([nationwide.co.uk](https://www.nationwide.co.uk/current-accounts/flexdirect))

To qualify, you must **pay in £1,500 each month**; transfers from other Nationwide accounts and refunds don’t count. It must also be your first FlexDirect in three years in your sole name, or with the same joint holder. ([nationwide.co.uk](https://www.nationwide.co.uk/current-accounts/flexdirect))

If you’re happy to keep the money in a **separate savings account linked to a current account**, two options pay more:

- **For a lump sum:** Santander Edge Saver pays **6% AER variable on up to £4,000**, including a first-year bonus. The standard Edge current account costs **£3 a month**, so factor that fee into the comparison. ([santander.co.uk](https://www.santander.co.uk/personal/savings-and-investments/savings/santander-edge-saver?utm_source=openai))
- **For monthly savings:** Santander Regular Saver pays **8% AER variable for the first year** on deposits of up to **£200 a month**. Santander’s **fee-free Everyday current account** qualifies, so you don’t need to pay for Edge to get this rate. ([santander.co.uk](https://www.santander.co.uk/personal/savings-and-investments/savings/regular-saver?icid=php-r1_t2-Regular%2520eSaver-0917&utm_source=openai))
